note: ML-210 rules A1/A2: every foreground/background token pair the app actually uses, checked in both themes by scripts/a11y-audit.mjs. kind=text needs 4.5:1 (min overrides, e.g. 3 for large text); kind=non-text (control edges, state indicators, focus ring) needs 3:1. A background with transparency is composited over `over` (default --container-bg). Add a pair whenever a component puts a new token combination on screen.
